title: Flashcards: Birds, scientific names
intro: Flip each card about birds. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Indian Pond Heron?
cards.explain: The Indian Pond Heron is Ardeola grayii.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Imperial Woodpecker?
cards.explain: The Imperial Woodpecker is Campephilus imperialis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Purple Roller?
cards.explain: The Purple Roller is Coracias naevius.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Elegant Imperial Pigeon?
cards.explain: The Elegant Imperial Pigeon is Ducula concinna.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Black-necked Stork?
cards.explain: The Black-necked Stork is Ephippiorhynchus asiaticus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Madagascar Serpent Eagle?
cards.explain: The Madagascar Serpent Eagle is Eutriorchis astur.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Weka?
What is the scientific name of the Buff-banded Rail?
cards.explain: The Buff-banded Rail is Gallirallus philippensis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Pacific Diver?
cards.explain: The Pacific Diver is Gavia pacifica.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the European shag?
cards.explain: The European shag is Gulosus aristotelis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Western Yellow Wagtail?
cards.explain: The Western Yellow Wagtail is Motacilla flava.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Lawes's Parotia?

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Red-faced Cormorant?
cards.explain: The Red-faced Cormorant is Phalacrocorax urile.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Forster's Tern?

cards.explain: The Eared Dove is Zenaida auriculata.
